android-actions|Button.summary: A Plenix button on Android is the Material 3 Button, kept native in behavior (the ripple, the 48 dp touch target, TalkBack’s button role, keyboard and D-pad focus, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: a 6 dp rounded rectangle 40 dp tall, a DM Sans semibold label at the label text role (Label large) and the Plenix action colors. Material’s default is a fully rounded container in the theme’s primary color with a Roboto label; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.

android-actions|Icon button.summary: A Plenix icon button on Android is the Material 3 icon button, kept native in behavior (the ripple, the 48 dp touch target, TalkBack reading its label, a tooltip on long press) and styled with the Plenix tokens: a 40 dp square with a 6 dp radius, a 20 dp Material Symbol and the Plenix button colors. Material’s default is a circle in the theme colors; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look. Every icon button has a label, read by TalkBack and shown as its tooltip.

variants.name: Outlined

variants.name: Toggle

anatomy.name: Tooltip
anatomy.about: The label, shown on long press or pointer hover, in the Plenix tooltip colors.

android-actions|Menu.summary: A Plenix menu on Android is the Material 3 menu (DropdownMenu in Compose, a popup list in Views), kept native in behavior (it opens from its button, closes on a tap outside or Back, moves focus with the keyboard or D-pad, and TalkBack reads its items) and styled with the Plenix menu tokens: an overlay surface with an 8 dp radius and a 1 dp border, 48 dp rows, DM Sans labels at the body text role and the Plenix danger and disabled colors. Material’s default is a tonal surface with a 4 dp radius and Roboto labels; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look. Plenix decides the content as on every platform: short verb labels, sections in place of long lists, a check for toggles and destructive items last.

variants.name: Item
variants.views: A row in a ListPopupWindow (or an <item> in a PopupMenu)
variants.use: An action on the thing the menu belongs to, such as Rename.

variants.name: Checked item
variants.material: Menu item with a trailing check
variants.compose: DropdownMenuItem with trailingIcon = a check when on; semantics toggleableState
variants.use: An on or off option, such as Show hidden files; the menu stays open after the change.

variants.name: Danger item
variants.material: Menu item in the error color
variants.compose: DropdownMenuItem with MenuDefaults.itemColors(textColor = the danger color)
variants.views: A row with the danger text color
variants.use: A destructive action, such as Delete; it goes last, after a divider.

variants.name: Disabled item
variants.use: An action that does not apply now but is worth showing, so the menu keeps its shape.

variants.name: Section title
variants.compose: A Text with semantics { heading() } above its items, a HorizontalDivider between sections
variants.views: <group> with a header row; a divider between groups
variants.use: A short name over a set of related items in a longer menu.
